reason: Since the installed release (63db1c2) the schema gained the table cq_installation_settings, which holds the installation's layer of the agent configuration (InstallationSetting.Agents), and the stored type Attempt (cq_usage_attempts.body) gained the field effort. dev/local-update.sql creates the table as server/src/main/resources/db/001-ledgers.sql declares it, records that schema's hash, and adds a null effort to every stored attempt lacking the field; the updater verifies that nothing else changed and that the updated database has the structure the new schema declares. The other changes to stored data need no transformation: cq_project_settings.body gained the branches Mode and Agents of ProjectSetting, and the enumerations AttemptState, ChildEnd, DispatchPhase, ChildNext and ArtifactKind gained values (Abstained, Arbitrate, Submit, Editing, Panel), which no stored row holds. The remaining model changes are request and reply types (the agent configuration and process mode commands, StartChoice and Start without a harness, AssignedWork, the dispatch commands Seats, OpenWorkspace, SubmitWorkspace and SelfReview, the mode in workflow context, receipt and Context, the Help catalog's modes) and files of a session directory, which no update converts: run.json, a child's ticket.json and unacknowledged delivery batches hold an Attempt, so the session directories of the installed release are unreadable to this one. Project archives are not converted either; an archive of the installed release is refused by its schema hash.
